newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate at 6-month high, funds tight.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate at 6-month high, funds tight.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate surged to a new six-month high late on Thursday due to high seasonal demand for funds at the Chinese Lunar New Year and ahead of banks' reserves deadline on Friday, dealers said.
The heavy buying of the dollar in the foreign exchange market also affected the money supply, dealers said.
The interbank rate jumped to 20.00-22.00 percent late from 19.00-20.00 in the early morning, dealers said.
"Most were quoting the interbank rate at 20.00 percent this afternoon. But some banks was offered the rate as high as 24 percent in late trade," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
